title: the ballast and ballast48 read free memory differently on a card with driver-reserved memory

findings.claim: the 48 GB run m48-20261119T232459Z-d28f6c0305fa ended at s07 with nothing measured: tools/ballast.py hold read nvidia-smi memory.free (49140 MiB, ready) while tools/ballast48.py check took total minus used (49776 MiB), which adds the 636 MiB driver 580 reserves, and refused
findings.severity_basis: a paid run ended with nothing measured and every relaunch on this card would end the same way; the VM stopped itself, nothing harmed and no false record made
findings.fix: one reading of the card (tools/ballast.py read_card, nvidia-smi memory.free) for the holder and ballast48; hold corrects the holder from that figure (at most 8 steps, to within 64 MiB), refuses off-target with the numbers, re-reads after 2 s before ready; tolerance still 512 MiB; the s07 note names the refusal's figures; stand-in card with the run's figures in tests/unit/test_ballast_reserved_h66.py
findings.from: the integrator's card H-66 and the run's ballast.log and s07-ballast.log, 2026-11-20
